snippet.title: Arcane Path - demo release trailer
snippet.description:
Arcane Path is a narrative roguelike deckbuilder where the story advances via book-like events and NPC dialogues. Its standout feature is a diverse artifact system: every artifact bestows special mechanics and status effects, ensuring that each run feels fresh.
